variation.name: rsi2_uptrend_pullback
variation.description: RSI(2) < 10 pullback in confirmed uptrend (above 200d SMA). Tight 5% TP.
variation.entry_rule: RSI(2)<10 AND close>200d SMA AND RSI(14)>40
variation.academic_basis: Connors RSI(2) mean reversion, filtered by primary trend

variation.name: analyst_consensus_capped
variation.description: Yahoo analyst consensus with realistic TP cap (8% large, 15% small). Requires 10+ analysts.
variation.entry_rule: RSI(14)<45 AND above 200d SMA AND ADX>20 (value entry proxy)
variation.academic_basis: Analyst consensus contrarian (Barber et al. 2001), TP capped to realistic swing level

variation.name: momentum_relative_strength
variation.description: Top quartile RS vs SPY, EMA stack aligned, volume breakout.
variation.entry_rule: EMA 9>21>50>200 (full stack) AND volume>1.5x 20d avg AND above 200d SMA
variation.academic_basis: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) momentum, filtered by relative strength

variation.name: mean_reversion_50sma
variation.description: Z-score reversion from 50d SMA in uptrend. Buy oversold dips.
variation.entry_rule: z-score from 50d SMA < -1.5 AND above 200d SMA AND RSI(14)<35
variation.academic_basis: Mean reversion to moving average, Poterba & Summers (1988)

variation.name: quality_value_trend
variation.description: High RS + pullback to 21d EMA in strong trend. Quality value entry.
variation.entry_rule: Close within 1% of EMA21 AND above 200d SMA AND ADX>25 AND RSI(14)<55
variation.academic_basis: Asness et al. (2019) quality factor + trend following
